trailhead.label: Car park by the bridge over the Lago di Verzegnis, via Ambiesta below Chiaicis, the board’s start

cautions: Parts of this walk are exposed; keep your dog close and on a short lead.
Several suspension bridges without side rails on the way back: carry or closely hold your dog, or take the road via Chiaicis instead.
Slippery, exposed stretches: not in uncertain weather, snow or ice.
The dam crest and a short stretch of tarred road.
No water point is listed on this walk: carry enough for you and your dog.
Follow local signs, lead rules and temporary closures.

emergency.note: Call the European emergency number when urgent help is required. Connectivity is not guaranteed.
